Nami Daidouji is a Taimanin, introduced in Taimanin RPGX.

She has a Ninja Art, which increases her size to giant proportions.

Why not just master the ways of the hero, the otaku and the gal?!
Daidouji Nami


Personality
She likes how she grows into a giant when she uses her technique, but is embarrassed when she is seen from below.

Nami has a bright, positive, and honest personality, and is highly empathetic. When people ask her for advice, she will be there for them, laughing and crying with them. She is an otaku gal who has recently become addicted to anime. From anime, she has also come to like erotic games, and is the type of person who can enjoy erotic works as "works" without the eroticism. Until a few years ago, there were no women with bigger breasts than hers around, so Nami was confident in her breasts, but when she met Mikami Chizu and Kousaka Shizuru, her world changed completely. Her favorite food is the food that appears in anime. So it changes all the time.

Often jokes with others, nudges them, at times a bit inappropriate. Often makes reference to otaku or gyaru culture.

Appearance
She has blue eyes and blonde hair.

History
Background
A Taimanin and second year student of Gosha Academy.

She is a user of the Giant Art, Even in her normal state, she has the same superhuman strength as Yatsu Murasaki. Has yet to fully master her own size increasing ´Ninja Art and uses a control device developed by the Gosha Science Team. The control device is built into her Taimanin suit and the accessories she wears

Timeline RPG
Assisted in an investigation mission, with the Independent Commando Unit, joined by Bondo Maria, Hazamada Kirino, Fuuma Kotaro, Hisashige Nana. She would investigate the research lab of Belphegor, which performed the research on Faurecia. The group rescued Dajame from the location and was able to kill a clone of Muscle Joe. It was her strength that granted victory. Some time, later, most of the group would watch Nami's training under Fuuma Kotaro. Nami though only able to use her giant form for three minutes was able to defeat simulated versions of the Hydra, Ōnyūdō and Cetus. However, reports reached the group of a large monster in Tokyo, Shinminato-ku. As they arrived, the monster had disappeared, but as they continued their search on foot, they followed the traces of Belphegor. White Don assisted the group and was also a fan of Nami, which he viewed like an idol heroine. As the group caught up with Belphegor, Nami got ready to fight him, but he summoned Kaiju X again. Nami fought against the large lizard herself, ⁣however, numerous small enemies exhausted the energy and during a beam battle, she was about to lose until she was given the cheers of the orc crowd and help from Lune and Linoa Seling, giving her more energy.

Nami was called again during a mission to rescue Kannagi Eiha, she fought together with the flashy Jigokumaru Akira. As the research ship, that Eiha was kept in, was cut in half, Nami grew in size and rescued the people still on board with her size.

Moved to the third year, in Gosha Academy, after the events between Nisha Ninja Troops and Independent Commando Unit.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Bracelets Limiter

Ninja Art: "Body Transformation Art", "Giant Art", can increase her own body size is only able to control it with a control device which is in her suit. Can take this form for about three minutes and then requires a bit of time until she can use it again. However, without the control device would be even more limited, unable to control her Ninja Art fully.
Super Human Strength: Even when not using her Ninja Art, it rivals the strength of other strength users like Murasaki. Quick punches can release shockwaves when in her giant form. Releases energy stored in her star shaped control device to shoot laser beams.
Scanner: Typically wears a scanner, which shows her enemy weak points.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
Media
Taimanin RPGX
Trivia
Typically gives her attacks odd names with strange abbreviations on the spot.
Makes a reference to Neon Genesis Evangelion, when people argue how to increase the strength of her control device, which gives her energy. As she is limited by three minutes, it is suggested they could use like a power cable, which she considered too hard to fight with. This being a clear reference to the "Umbilical Cable" of NGE.
She herself might be a reference to Ultraman.
Given the concept art, when her ability is active, she is about the size of 13,5 Yukikazes. She would rival at that point the height of Mount Lady from My Hero Academia.
